subject: general
question: Vishu festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala And Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vishu** is a significant festival in Kerala and Tamil Nadu, marking the beginning of the Malayalam new year.
 
• The festival usually falls in the month of April and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and traditional rituals.
 
• One of the key highlights of Vishu is the **Vishukkani**, an arrangement of auspicious items meant to be the first thing one sees on the morning of Vishu.
 
• It is a time for family gatherings, feasts, and the exchange of gifts, emphasizing prosperity and well-being for the coming year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishu**

 
 
• The word 'Vishu' means 'equal' in Sanskrit and marks the completion of the spring equinox, when day and night are of equal duration.
 
• The celebrations include traditional music, dance, and fireworks, making it a vibrant and joyous occasion.
 
• In Tamil Nadu, Vishu is celebrated as **Puthandu** or Tamil New Year with similar customs and traditions.
 
• Vishu is also known for the practice of giving money as gifts, called **Vishukkaineetam**, symbolizing blessings and good fortune.
 
 
 
• **Malayalam New Year**
 
 
• The Malayalam calendar is a solar calendar used in Kerala, with Vishu marking the first day of the month of Medam.
 
• Unlike other Indian festivals that follow the lunar calendar, Vishu follows the solar cycle, aligning with the sun's transit.
 
• The Malayalam New Year is an important cultural and religious event, reflecting Kerala's agrarian roots and seasonal cycles.
 
• It signifies new beginnings, growth, and the hope for a prosperous year ahead.
